messages:
leah.peopleops: Quick heads-up 1: we've rolled out three small handbook changes this morning: 1) parental & caregiver leave examples, 2) clarified PII handling for contractors, 3) performance cycle timeline note. Please skim and ACK by Mon 2026-04-06. Diff + plain-language summary: https://internal.redwood/handbook/changes/1763005123 

tariq-peopleops: Added a one-page manager cheat sheet to the repo with suggested language for conversations and a sample checklist for handoffs during leave. Link: https://internal.redwood/handbook/manager-cheatsheet.pdf 

emily-benefits: Benefit note: New flexible leave pay schedule for partial leaves (split-week) is live. Payroll needs names of anyone taking split-week leave before the payroll cutoff on 2026-04-09. If you're a manager with upcoming leaves, please DM me the dates.

zack-sre: Quick question: the PII clarification for contractors 1 mentions 'restricted access' by default. Does that mean contractors lose access to internal logs until they sign the contractor NDA addendum?

nina-legal: Correct 1 contractors who need access to logs must sign the new Contractor Data Addendum (CDA). Legal will route the CDA and retain signed copies. We'll update the templates repo after the ack window closes.

alex-recruiting: Note for hiring ops: update checklist in `templates/onboarding-checklist.md` to include `sign-cda.md` for contractors that need log/PII access. I'll open a PR and link it here when ready. Also tagging @leah.peopleops for any required wording.

onboarding-bot: New assignment: "Handbook update: PII & Leave (Apr 2026)" assigned to all active employees. Course length 18m. Enrollment link: https://training.redwood/assign/handbook-apr-2026.

compliance-bot: Reminder: mandatory ack + micro-course due 2026-04-13. Weekly digest will be sent to managers every Fri. Completion report to managers on 2026-04-14.

tariq-peopleops: Also pushed a short performance-cycle note: mid-year calibration window moved up one week to accommodate external audits. Calendar event created for managers: "Mid-year calibration" on 2026-06-08 10:00 PT. See `handbook/performance/timeline.md` for updated dates.

emily-benefits: For comp cycle overlaps: employees on paid leave during calibration should still be included; managers can submit a written context note using the `performance/exceptions/form` before 2026-06-01.

zack-sre: Managers, I'll need confirmation if any of your ICs will be on leave between 2026-05-25 and 2026-06-10 so the oncall rota can be adjusted. Please reply with names here or DM me.

leah.peopleops: To keep things tidy: 1) ACK the handbook changes in the repo, 2) managers confirm they've updated team onboarding checklist, 3) contractors that require PII access get added to the contractor tracker and sent the CDA. I'll compile an ack + completion report next Thu.

alex-recruiting: PR opened: `templates/onboarding-checklist.md` #94 with `sign-cda` step.

nina-legal: I'll review benefit language for regional nuance and add a short footnote for EU employees (local law override).

leah.peopleops: Thanks everyone. If questions: drop them here or join 15-min office hours Fri 9:30am PT. I'll post slides afterwards in #people-ops-resources. :sparkles:
